title: maximin_eq_one_quarter
body_html:
maximin_eq_one_quarter

Lean type

lean theorem maximin_eq_one_quarter : -- Witness x = y = 1/2 achieves at least 1/4 against every z. (∀ z, 0 ≤ z → z ≤ 1 → (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ G (1/2) (1/2) z) ∧ -- Upper bound: every (x,y) ∈ [0,1]² has min_z G(x,y,z) ≤ 1/4. (∀ x y, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ y → y ≤ 1 → min (x * y) ((1 - x) * (1 - y)) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ))

Dependencies

  • maximin_lower_bound
  • maximin_upper_bound
